about: The Ink Chronicle archetype registry (roadmap 7.3 and 7.4, ICW-03; D-97): the 20 archetypes of research report F.1 with their default lane, fallback, Blender technique, camera language and reuse, and the 23 lane sub-categories of brief section 5 with the twelve attributes each one carries. Read by visual/shot_design.py (ShotDesigner) and visual/lanes.py (LanePlanner); validated by schemas/archetypes_ic.schema.json plus shot_design.registry_errors. Shares, tolerances and shot caps are never stored here: they are BP-108 and BP-109's (standards/sourced_rules.json). Planner weights below are heuristics (HYP), not validator thresholds. archetypes_ic/2 (2026-11-06, D-116): every sub-category carries its route (J2, J4, J5 or H), an optional route_alt (LTX_A2V = the D-90 audio-driven LTX clip) and route_status (T until the phase-3 test, then confirmed or rejected); visual/lanes.py writes the route into every planned shot.

planner.video_run_max_evidence: HYP: roadmap 7.2 ('a VIDEO_3D run of more than three consecutive shots without a STILL_3D or HELPER is REVIEW'); REVIEW only (KP-48); proposed as a sourced_rules row for ICW-07
planner.intensity_evidence: HYP: beat intensity first (roadmap 7.3 share sanity); the weights rank shots for the margin swaps and decide nothing alone
planner.scene_mode_still_penalty_evidence: HYP: a played scene shot with an acted peak on a held plate is KP-37's REVIEW, so the planner turns narrated, establishing and insert shots into stills first

archetypes.name: battle
archetypes.title: Battle / mass conflict
archetypes.blender_technique: instanced crowd (Geometry Nodes), 2-3 Mixamo cycles, silhouette depth layers, volumetric dust
archetypes.camera_language: wide or extreme wide, eye or high angle; a slow rail along the line or a held frame while the mass moves; never handheld

archetypes.name: duel
archetypes.title: Duel / one-on-one

fallback.note: STILL_3D freeze on the peak pose

archetypes.blender_technique: two rigged characters, camera on a rail, line art on
archetypes.camera_language: medium or medium close-up on the actor, the opponent's shoulder in frame; the rail tracks the action's direction; keep the 180-degree line

archetypes.name: two_person_dialogue
archetypes.title: Two-person dialogue
archetypes.blender_technique: shot-reverse-shot template, Rhubarb mouth shapes on 8 shape keys
archetypes.camera_language: matched over-the-shoulder pair or medium close-ups, eye level, static; the voiced close-up stays within BP-108's dialogue cap

archetypes.name: council
archetypes.title: Council / group

fallback.note: VIDEO_3D for the speaking beat (close-up of the voiced line)

archetypes.blender_technique: tableau plate at wide; close-up VIDEO for voiced lines
archetypes.camera_language: a wide that shows the whole table or ring, then medium close-ups of whoever speaks; the wide is held

archetypes.name: solitary_emotion
archetypes.title: Solitary emotion

fallback.note: VIDEO only if a gesture carries the beat

archetypes.blender_technique: portrait plate, drift; VIDEO only if a gesture carries the beat
archetypes.camera_language: close-up or medium close-up, eye level or slightly low; a slow drift in, never a cut inside the beat

archetypes.name: crafting
archetypes.title: Crafting / work
archetypes.blender_technique: hands + tool animation loop, macro camera
archetypes.camera_language: insert or extreme close-up on the hands and the tool, static or a short push; shallow depth

archetypes.name: travel
archetypes.title: Travel / journey
archetypes.blender_technique: camera dolly over terrain/sea, character cycle, parallax clouds
archetypes.camera_language: wide, the subject entering or leaving frame along the screen direction of the journey; a dolly with them or a held frame they cross

archetypes.name: exploration
archetypes.title: Exploration / discovery
archetypes.blender_technique: slow reveal camera through a set
archetypes.camera_language: medium wide behind the explorer's shoulder, a slow dolly through the set toward what is found

archetypes.name: reveal
archetypes.title: Reveal
archetypes.blender_technique: push-in + light change
archetypes.camera_language: push in on the thing revealed, or pull back to show its size; the light changes on the beat

archetypes.name: chase
archetypes.title: Chase
archetypes.blender_technique: tracking camera, two cycles
archetypes.camera_language: tracking alongside or behind the pursuer, screen direction constant across cuts

archetypes.name: establishing
archetypes.title: Environmental establishing

fallback.note: VIDEO_3D if weather carries the shot

archetypes.blender_technique: wide plate, 2.5D parallax or Blender camera drift
archetypes.camera_language: extreme wide or wide, eye level or high; a slow parallax or drift, the horizon on a third

archetypes.name: map
archetypes.title: Map
archetypes.blender_technique: Python maps/render.py; Blender terrain DEFER-BEHIND-TEST (ICD-16, D-112)
archetypes.camera_language: top-down or tilted map, one move per beat (route draws, units slide); the HELPER renderer's own grammar

archetypes.name: abstract_explanation
archetypes.title: Abstract explanation
archetypes.blender_technique: Python HUD and graph renderers; Blender only for 3D diagrams (DEFER)
archetypes.camera_language: flat graphic frame; the number or the comparison builds on the narrator's word

archetypes.name: time_passing
archetypes.title: Transformation / time passing
archetypes.blender_technique: material/light keyframes on one set, sun arc
archetypes.camera_language: a locked wide while the light, the season or the set changes; or two matched plates dissolved

archetypes.name: crowd_ceremony
archetypes.title: Crowd / ceremony
archetypes.blender_technique: as 1 with slower motion
archetypes.camera_language: wide on the gathering, a slow drift or crane; faces only in the foreground rank

archetypes.name: aftermath
archetypes.title: Aftermath
archetypes.blender_technique: plate, slow drift
archetypes.camera_language: wide or medium wide over what is left, high angle or eye level; a slow drift, nothing moves but smoke or wind

archetypes.name: narrator_over_evidence
archetypes.title: Narrator over evidence
archetypes.blender_technique: Python tableau / cutaway / dossier card
archetypes.camera_language: the object or document fills the frame; a slow push to the detail the narrator names

archetypes.name: cold_open
archetypes.title: Cold open
archetypes.blender_technique: the episode's strongest 9/10 beat, <= 15 s
archetypes.camera_language: the payoff shot's own framing, cut short (KP-41): pieces of the conflict to come

archetypes.name: climax
archetypes.title: Climax
archetypes.blender_technique: full motion, justified Cycles (render_profile cycles_hero needs a why)
archetypes.camera_language: the episode's widest and closest frames in alternation; motion carries every shot

archetypes.name: ending
archetypes.title: Ending
archetypes.blender_technique: plate, long drift into the credits
archetypes.camera_language: a wide or a portrait held long, drifting out; the last frame is a composition, not a cut

sub_categories.name: strategic / route / territory map
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: the narrator says where armies, roads, supply or borders are and the next beat depends on that geography
sub_categories.when_not: a character decides or acts on screen; a place that a STILL_3D establishing plate can show; more than BP-141's map run in a row

shot_design.camera: one move per beat: a route draws, a unit slides, a border fills
shot_design.composition: the moving element on a third, north up, labels outside the action
shot_design.screen_direction: west-east movement keeps the episode's screen direction (the side each army entered from)

motion.prop: unit tokens slide on the route
motion.secondary: a pulse on the token the narrator names

look.material: the world bible's paper and ink tokens through edit/style_bridge.py (ICW-05)
look.palette: bible palette, one accent per side

duration.guidance: as long as the narrator's sentence about the geography; the map renderer's own grammar (CMP rules)

blender_strategy.scene_template: none: Python maps/render.py (Blender terrain is DEFER-BEHIND-TEST, D-112)

audio_and_continuity.audio: narrator over a low bed; a soft tick on each token move
audio_and_continuity.continuity: token colours and sides match the armies' sides in the VIDEO shots

assertions: helper_archetype is a MAP catalogue id
every label is a claim with a source (ZI-02)
failure_modes: a map that says what a scene should play
two maps in a row (VP-06)
qa.recovery: give the beat back to a STILL_3D or VIDEO_3D shot of the same place

sub_categories.name: timeline stepper
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: a date, a jump in time or an order of events the viewer must hold
sub_categories.when_not: the date is said once in passing; a transformation shot (archetype 14) can show the time change itself

shot_design.camera: the step slides to the new date
shot_design.composition: the dated mark centred, neighbours faded
shot_design.screen_direction: time runs left to right

look.palette: bible palette, the current era's accent

duration.guidance: the narrator's dated sentence

blender_strategy.scene_template: none: Python maps/render.py timeline layer

audio_and_continuity.continuity: the same date format through the episode

assertions: the date is in the claim map
failure_modes: a date nobody needs to remember
qa.recovery: drop the stepper and say the date over the next shot

sub_categories.name: chart / counter
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: the narrator gives a number, a range or a count that decides the story (range, men, horses, losses)
sub_categories.when_not: the number is colour, not stakes; the number has no claim

shot_design.camera: static; the bar or counter builds
shot_design.composition: one number large, its unit beside it
shot_design.screen_direction: the larger side on the side its army holds

motion.prop: the counter rolls or the bar grows on the narrator's word

look.palette: bible palette, the two sides' accents

duration.guidance: the number's sentence; the build lands on the spoken number

blender_strategy.scene_template: none: Python HUD renderer (edit/visual_compensator.py)

audio_and_continuity.audio: narrator; a tick per step of the counter
audio_and_continuity.continuity: the same unit and rounding everywhere the number returns

assertions: every shown number is a claim (ZI-02)
failure_modes: a counter over a played beat
qa.recovery: say the number over a STILL_3D plate instead

sub_categories.name: cutaway / process / network diagram
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: how something works: a weapon, a supply chain, a chain of command, a method
sub_categories.when_not: a VIDEO_3D crafting shot can show the process done by a person

shot_design.camera: static; parts appear in the order the narrator names them
shot_design.composition: the object centred, callouts outside it
shot_design.screen_direction: flow left to right

motion.prop: parts slide apart or light up

duration.guidance: one step per narrator clause

blender_strategy.scene_template: none: Python compensator archetypes (cutaway, tech tree)

audio_and_continuity.audio: narrator; mechanical foley on each part
audio_and_continuity.continuity: the object matches its prop in the VIDEO shots

failure_modes: a diagram longer than its explanation
qa.recovery: cut the diagram to the parts the narrator names

sub_categories.name: comparison
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: two sides, two methods or two outcomes set side by side (the episode's question, a verdict)
sub_categories.when_not: the comparison is played by the characters in the same frame

shot_design.camera: static; a split that fills side by side
shot_design.composition: two columns, each side on its army's screen side
shot_design.screen_direction: each side keeps its screen side from the scenes

motion.prop: rows fill on the narrator's words

duration.guidance: the comparison sentence

blender_strategy.scene_template: none: Python split-screen / verdict matrix

audio_and_continuity.audio: narrator; a soft hit when the verdict lands
audio_and_continuity.continuity: sides as in the scenes

failure_modes: a matrix that answers before the story does
qa.recovery: move it after the scene that earns it

sub_categories.name: evidence callout
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: the narrator points at the record: a source, a count that sources dispute, a document, a date in a letter
sub_categories.when_not: the evidence is invented for the episode's fiction (RR rules: never present fiction as a record)

shot_design.camera: a slow push to the detail named
shot_design.composition: the document fills the frame; the quoted line highlighted
shot_design.screen_direction: none

duration.guidance: the narrator's sentence about the record

blender_strategy.scene_template: none: Python dossier card / cutaway

audio_and_continuity.continuity: the same card style for every record in the episode

assertions: the card shows only sourced text
failure_modes: a fabricated document
qa.recovery: say it over a STILL_3D plate with no document

sub_categories.name: establishing tableau
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: a new place or a return to one after a time jump; the viewer needs the geography before the action
sub_categories.when_not: weather or motion carries the beat (then VIDEO_3D archetype 11); the place was shown in the shot before

shot_design.camera: parallax_25d or a Blender camera drift
shot_design.composition: horizon on a third, the place's landmark on the opposite third
shot_design.screen_direction: the side the next action enters from is open

look.lighting: the scene's light rig at its key time
look.atmosphere: fog or dust layer if the place has it

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s; long enough for the place word

blender_strategy.scene_template: the era's set kit

audio_and_continuity.continuity: the plate is the scene's set; later shots keep its light

failure_modes: an empty plate where the story needs a person
qa.recovery: add the scene's lead in the foreground or make it VIDEO_3D

sub_categories.name: character tableau
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: one character's state: a look, a decision, a reaction that needs no motion
sub_categories.when_not: a gesture carries the beat (VIDEO_3D); a voiced line with a visible mouth (VIDEO_3D lip-sync)

shot_design.camera: drift in or hold
shot_design.composition: eyes on the upper third, look room on the side they face
shot_design.screen_direction: the character faces the side of whoever they react to

motion.secondary: a drift of the camera only

look.lighting: portrait light rig, key from the scene's light source

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s

blender_strategy.scene_template: the scene's set, the character in their approved pose

audio_and_continuity.audio: narrator or the other speaker off screen
audio_and_continuity.continuity: costume and props as in the previous shot (continuity_ref)

failure_modes: a mouth that should speak
qa.recovery: turn it into the VIDEO_3D lip-sync shot

sub_categories.name: group tableau
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: who is in the room and where they stand: a council, an envoy before a court, a ring of riders
sub_categories.when_not: the group moves as one (VIDEO_3D archetype 1 or 15)

shot_design.camera: hold or a slow drift
shot_design.composition: the power figure on the axis, the others in depth
shot_design.screen_direction: as the scene's stage (KP-26)

motion.environment: fire flicker baked as one frame

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s

blender_strategy.scene_template: hall / tent set kit with the cast placed

audio_and_continuity.audio: room tone, the speaker off screen
audio_and_continuity.continuity: the same stage positions in every shot of the scene

failure_modes: a speaker's line on a tableau with a visible mouth
qa.recovery: cut to the VIDEO_3D close-up for the line

sub_categories.name: detail / macro insert
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: the object that matters: a sack, a glove, a pinned pack, a weapon
sub_categories.when_not: the object's motion is the beat (VIDEO_3D archetype 6)

shot_design.camera: hold or a short push
shot_design.composition: the object on the centre or a third, shallow depth
shot_design.screen_direction: the object points along the scene's direction

look.material: bible ink line; prop material from the library

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s; usually 2-4 s

blender_strategy.scene_template: a prop on a ground plane, set lights

audio_and_continuity.audio: a foley accent on the object
audio_and_continuity.continuity: the prop as in the wide shots

assertions: the prop is a library asset with a licence
failure_modes: an insert with no story job
qa.recovery: cut it

sub_categories.name: atmospheric / aftermath tableau
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: what is left after an event, or the mood before one: smoke, ash, an empty field, the ending
sub_categories.when_not: the aftermath still moves (VIDEO_3D archetype 16's V9)

shot_design.camera: a slow drift
shot_design.composition: the remains low in frame, empty sky above
shot_design.screen_direction: none

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s

blender_strategy.scene_template: the battle set after: burned props, scattered kit

audio_and_continuity.continuity: the same set as the battle

failure_modes: too many aftermath plates in a row
qa.recovery: alternate with a character tableau

sub_categories.name: contrast / match composition
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: two eras, two sides or before/after in one composed frame or a matched pair
sub_categories.when_not: the contrast is a number (HELPER comparison)

shot_design.camera: hold, or the second plate matched on the first
shot_design.composition: the two subjects mirrored across the centre
shot_design.screen_direction: each side on its own screen side

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s per plate

blender_strategy.scene_template: two set kits on one stage, or two renders

audio_and_continuity.continuity: both halves keep their scenes' looks

failure_modes: a split that reads as a template
qa.recovery: make it one composition

sub_categories.name: held / freeze tableau
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: the peak of an action frozen: the instant before impact, the title beat, a reveal held
sub_categories.when_not: the motion itself is the information (VIDEO_3D)

shot_design.camera: hold or dramatic_curve (BP-170)
shot_design.composition: the peak pose on the power point of the frame
shot_design.screen_direction: the action's direction kept

duration.guidance: at most BP-109's still_shot_max_s; BP-170 for the curve

blender_strategy.scene_template: the VIDEO shot's scene at its peak frame

audio_and_continuity.audio: the impact sound or a hold of silence
audio_and_continuity.continuity: the pose matches the frames around it

failure_modes: an acted beat that needs the motion (KP-37 REVIEW)
qa.recovery: give it back to VIDEO_3D

sub_categories.name: battle / siege / formation
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: armies meet, a formation holds or breaks, a charge, a volley
sub_categories.when_not: the geography is the point (HELPER map); the aftermath (STILL_3D)

shot_design.camera: rail along the line or locked
shot_design.composition: the clash on the centre third, depth layers
shot_design.screen_direction: each army keeps its side (KP-26)

duration.guidance: up to BP-108's non_dialogue_video_max_s when a continuous action benefits

blender_strategy.scene_template: battlefield set + crowd rig

audio_and_continuity.audio: the action's loudest sound on the peak
audio_and_continuity.continuity: the same formation geometry as the map

failure_modes: crowd strobing at 24 fps
qa.recovery: slow the cycle or move to the STILL_3D dramatic curve

sub_categories.name: character action / duel
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: one or two characters act: a strike, a draw, a fall, a pursuit
sub_categories.when_not: the beat is the reaction, not the action (STILL_3D character tableau)

shot_design.camera: rail with the action or locked
shot_design.composition: the actor and the target in one frame
shot_design.screen_direction: the action's direction constant across cuts

duration.guidance: up to BP-108's non_dialogue_video_max_s; a guided last frame after keypose_after_s

blender_strategy.scene_template: the scene's set, duel cam rig

audio_and_continuity.continuity: pose at the cut matches the next shot

assertions: identity CLIP check on close frames
failure_modes: retarget foot sliding
qa.recovery: hand-keyed cycle (ICW-06 fallback)

sub_categories.name: dialogue / negotiation
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: a voiced character line with a visible mouth (lipsync true, dialogue_cover on_screen)
sub_categories.when_not: the mouth is not seen (off_screen cover: STILL_3D listener or a VIDEO_3D cutaway)

shot_design.camera: static
shot_design.composition: eyes on the upper third, the listener's shoulder for OTS
shot_design.screen_direction: shot-reverse-shot keeps the 180-degree line

motion.character: Rhubarb mouth shapes on 8 shape keys, blinks, a gesture

look.lighting: the set's key on the speaker

blender_strategy.scene_template: dialogue template on the scene's set

audio_and_continuity.continuity: eyelines match across the pair

assertions: lip-sync within the line's spine window
failure_modes: mouth off the line
qa.recovery: re-run Rhubarb on the final take, or cover off screen

sub_categories.name: group dialogue / council
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: the speaking beat of a council: the one who speaks, seen speaking
sub_categories.when_not: the wide of the room (STILL_3D group tableau)

shot_design.camera: static
shot_design.composition: the speaker with one listener in depth
shot_design.screen_direction: as the stage of the wide

motion.character: mouth shapes, a gesture, listeners breathe

duration.guidance: at most BP-108's dialogue_shot_max_s

blender_strategy.scene_template: hall set with the cast placed

audio_and_continuity.continuity: stage positions of the wide

sub_categories.name: crafting / building / repair
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: hands do work the story needs: load a gun, draw a plan, fill a pot

shot_design.composition: hands and tool centred
shot_design.screen_direction: work moves left to right

audio_and_continuity.continuity: the tool as in the wides

sub_categories.name: travel / traversal
sub_categories.purpose_and_trigger: someone goes from one place to another and the going matters: a march, a ride, a retreat

sub_categories.name: reveal / discovery
